name: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies M. N. R.-10 (General Area)
benefit: - **Monetary Benefit:** Financial assistance for setting up irrigation infrastructure (such as pumps and motors) for cooperative societies.
_eligibility_text: - Cooperative irrigation societies formed by small and marginal farmers, or any other farmers, are eligible under this scheme. - The society should be located within the state of Gujarat. - The Scheme is applicable to the General category.
